info.name: Paneliya Enterprise HRMS API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for Paneliya HRMS Backend API covering all 19 modules, DTO validations, and endpoints.

request.description: Returns service vitality information at /api.
Returns service vitality, version, and architecture information.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: JWT authentication, RBAC session switching, user accounts

request.description: Creates a new user credentials account with password and initializes their employee profile.

item.name: Login user and receive JWT session

request.description: Authenticates with email/password and returns a bearer JWT access token with full user details.

query.description: Token can also be passed as query parameter (?token=...)

request.description: Retrieves current user profile. Pass token in Authorization header, or as query param ?token=...

item.name: Instantly switch active session role for testing RBAC perspectives

request.description: Allows live evaluation of multi-role perspectives (Super Admin, HR, Manager, Employee, etc.).
Returns available demo users configured for testing different system roles.

item.name: List employees with search and filters

query.description: Search term across name, code, skills, department
Filter by Employee Status (Active, Probation, etc.)
Filter by Employment Type (Full-time, Contract, etc.)

request.description: Retrieves all employees with optional filters for full-text search, department, status, and employment type.
Onboards a new employee, initializes default leave balances, and logs an audit record.

item.name: Get employee details with all 11 tab summaries

variable.description: Employee ID or Employee Code (e.g., EMP-1)

request.description: Retrieves full profile, attendance, leaves, payroll, documents, assets, and performance records.
Updates employee details including salary, department, contact info, and tax settings.
Marks employee status as Inactive for compliance and audit preservation.

item.name: Organization
item.description: Departments, designations, branch locations, visual org hierarchy

item.name: List all departments with active employee count

request.description: Retrieves all departments along with dynamic headcount aggregates and department heads.
Adds a new business division or department.
Updates department attributes, leadership, or description.
Retrieves all organizational roles and job levels.
Adds a new job designation with salary pay-bands.
Lists all branch offices and headquarters locations.
Returns recursive tree data for rendering the enterprise organizational chart.

item.name: Attendance
item.description: Punch clock, biometric reader sync, manual regularizations

request.description: Retrieves attendance logs filtered by employee, date, or department.

item.name: Get current punch clock state for employee

request.description: Returns today’s check-in time, check-out time, current status, and hours logged so far.
Records time-stamp punch for start of workday and emits WebSocket event.
Records end-of-day clock out and calculates total hours and overtime.
Allows HR admins to insert or correct missed punches for attendance audits.

item.name: Biometric hardware machine sync (ZKTeco / eSSL device webhook)

request.description: Processes batched hardware reader punch logs and maps them to employee daily records.

item.name: Leaves
item.description: Leave applications, quotas & balance calculation, multi-level approvals

item.name: List all leave applications with status filter

query.description: Filter by leave status (Pending, Approved, Rejected)

request.description: Retrieves all leave requests filtered optionally by employee or approval status.
Retrieves annual balances for Casual, Sick, and Paid leave quotas.
Submits a new leave application, validates dates, generates in-app notifications, and fires WebSocket events.
Marks leave request as Approved, updates employee quota balance, and logs an audit entry.
Marks leave request as Rejected with recorded reason.

item.name: Payroll
item.description: Automated monthly payroll runs, salary slips, disbursement status

query.description: Filter by payroll status (Draft, Approved, Processed, Paid)

request.description: Retrieves monthly payroll disbursement records filtered by month, status, or employee ID.

item.name: Get formatted printable payslip by record ID

request.description: Returns structured company letterhead, employee info, detailed earnings, deductions, and net pay breakdown.

item.name: Generate monthly payroll run for all active employees

request.description: Executes automated batch calculation of gross pay, statutory PF, TDS, professional tax, and net disbursements.

item.name: Update payroll record status (Approved, Processed, Paid)

request.description: Progresses salary voucher through finance approval workflow.

Marks off department, asset return, finance settlement, and exit interview clearances. Automatically transitions status to Resigned once complete.
